item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We refuse to accept those deaths as the price of progress.

2. We cannot build superintelligent AI first and confront its consequences later. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to kill thousands of people. We demand prevention before deployment—not apologies after disaster.

3. We reject a race to superintelligent AI that puts human lives on the line. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. We must stop that future, not accelerate toward it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We will not treat those lives as an acceptable cost of innovation. We reject the idea that technological ambition excuses exposing the public to catastrophic harm. We demand enforceable limits on development, meaningful public oversight, and accountability for the organisations driving this race. We cannot wait for mass casualties before drawing a line. We must act while prevention remains possible, and we must insist that protecting human life takes priority over being first to build the most powerful machine.
